sloka: दक्षिणे बाधताम् द्वारे महा पार्श्व महा उदरौ ।हनूमान् पश्चिम द्वारम् निपीड्य पवन आत्मजः ॥६-३७-२८॥।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇe bādhatām dvāre mahā pārśva mahā udarau ।hanūmān paścima dvāram nipīḍya pavana ātmajaḥ ॥6-37-28॥।।

translations.english: "Let Hanuman, the wind god's son of unimaginable prowess, enter the west gate along with numerous Vanaras and press against the enemy."
